'''Beacon Sensors''' were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] installed on [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barges]]. The sensors allowed the ship to home in on [[Directional landing beacon|directional guidance beacons]] while in [[Spaceport/Legends|port]].<ref name="EGTD" />
